flows.title: Ask Grok a question
steps: Go to grok.com. There is no side navigation: Imagine, Settings, Sign in and Sign up sit in one row across the top right, and the prompt box is in the middle of the page.
Type the question into that box, whose accessible name is Ask Grok anything.
Attach, at the left of the row under the box, adds a file to the question before it is sent.
The control labelled Fast, at the right of that same row, opens the model menu — its accessible name is Model select.
Select Submit, next to Fast, to send the question.

flows.title: Make an image or a video with Imagine
steps: Open grok.com/imagine — Imagine is the top-right link on grok.com, and the page it opens is titled Grok Imagine.
Describe what you want in the box, whose accessible name is Ask Grok anything, the same wording the question page uses.
Choose Image, Video or Agent from the row of buttons under the box.
Upload adds a picture to work from, and Aspect Ratio sets the shape of the result.
Select Submit. The page also carries Text Edit and Precise Edit, and five links to ready-made templates — restyle, aspect ratio, photo edit, background removal and e-commerce listing.
Chat, at the top of this page, goes back to the question page.
